fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 48% match is a Weak Fit for this Elasticsearch search role at this stage.

**Strengths:**
- Java and Kotlin with Spring Boot, running the settlement service
- PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and RabbitMQ data storage experience
- Open-source bug fixes and code review habits

**Gaps:**
- No search or vector database experience (Elasticsearch, Solr)
- No HNSW, IVF or search algorithm background
- No MongoDB or Cassandra, and no AI-assisted development evidence

**Recommendation:** Build a small Java project with Elasticsearch or Lucene, add vector search (HNSW) to it, and contribute upstream before applying.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Search Relevance team needs engineers who can own hard problems in a codebase that is 99.8% Java and keep it readable while it gets faster. Speed under load is a problem I know well. At Lumen Payments, I cut p99 latency on our payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis.

I've spent 11 years building payment and event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python, most recently as a Senior Software Engineer designing and running a settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot on Kafka. I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, which meant owning technical design from start to finish and working through code review on every change. I haven't worked on search or vector databases, so I'd come to HNSW and Lucene as a strong backend engineer who is ready to learn them properly. I also fixed small bugs in an open-source Kotlin library during a planned career break, and I'm now returning to full-time engineering.

Your distributed, consensus-driven way of working suits how I like to build software: clear written communication, honest feedback on code and APIs, and steady incremental improvement. I'm available to talk whenever suits your team, and I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my backend experience could support your search work.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Elastic Hiring Team,

At Lumen Payments I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, and I've spent 11 years building Java-based backend systems, so owning a project from design to release is familiar work. I'm returning to full-time engineering after a career break, and I bring strong Java, code review and data store experience with PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a conversation any weekday this month and can start within a few weeks of an offer.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
